name: Flashlight
descriptionLines: &7Battery-powered light for dark areas.
&7The beam gives away your position.

name: Water Bucket
descriptionLines: &7Puts out fire and cancels fall damage when placed below you.
&7Single use per placement; pick it back up.

name: Geiger Counter
descriptionLines: &7Clicks faster the more radiation is around you.
&7Useful near nuclear blasts and fallout.

name: Placeable Cover
descriptionLines: &7Placeable armored plating for building instant hard cover.

name: Diamond Pickaxe
descriptionLines: &7Sturdy pickaxe for tunneling to flanking routes.

name: Portable Radar
descriptionLines: &7Deployable radar that detects nearby players.
&7Enemies can destroy it if they find it.

name: Heavy Steel Insert
descriptionLines: &7Provides extra projectile and exprosion protection, but makes you slightly slower

name: Slime Pads
descriptionLines: &7Bouncy pads that absorb fall damage.
&7Place them on boots to nullify fall damage

name: Area Projector
descriptionLines: &7Projects a temporary wall of blocks to shape the battlefield.
&7Needs a moment of setup before it works.

name: Ender Pearls
descriptionLines: &7Throw to teleport to where it lands.
&7You take fall damage on arrival.

name: Gas Mask
descriptionLines: &7Filters out poison gas and smoke effects.
&7The filter wears out over time.

name: Night Vision Goggles
descriptionLines: &7See clearly in the dark.
&7Bright flashes can briefly blind you.

name: EMP Gun
descriptionLines: &7Fires an electromagnetic pulse that disables electronics and tech gear.
&7Does little damage to players.
&7Does NOT disable drones and planes

name: IMS Turret
descriptionLines: &7Intelligent Munitions System that launches mini-missiles at enemies in range.
&7Limited ammo per unit and it can be destroyed.

name: Artillery Walkie-Talkie
descriptionLines: &7Field radio used by spotters to coordinate artillery fire.
&7Only useful if you actually have fire support.

name: Velvet Band-Aid
descriptionLines: &7Can fully heal your health at random when damanged

name: Carpet Bombing Caller
descriptionLines: &7Calls in a bomber to carpet-bomb a line across the target area.
&7Throw it, then take cover; friendly fire applies.

name: Napalm Strike Caller
descriptionLines: &7Calls in an airstrike that drops napalm over the target area.
&7The flames linger and keep the position blocked for a while.

name: Chemical Strike Caller
descriptionLines: &7Calls in a bomber that drops poison gas canisters.
&7Heavy area denial, but the gas drifts and hurts everyone.

name: Agent Orange Caller
descriptionLines: &7A heavier special airstrike than the standard callers.
&7Large impact zone: do not stand anywhere near the target.

name: Pilot detector
descriptionLines: &7A gadget which marks enemies which are controlling a drone through walls
&7Has a cooldown between uses

name: EMP Blast
descriptionLines: &7A gadget which emits an EMP field on use
&7In contact with the EMP field enemy gadgets get disabled and loose control
&7Has a cooldown between uses

name: Servo Set
descriptionLines: &7Increases speed and jump height

name: V1
descriptionLines: &7Fully heal on melee attacks

name: Totem of Undying
descriptionLines: &7Extra life!

name: Jumppack
descriptionLines: &7Personal propulsion system for enhanced mobility.
&7Enables rocket-assisted jumps for tactical advantage.

name: Grappling Hook
descriptionLines: &7Swing and reel yourself to new positions in a flash.
&7Takes practice and leaves you exposed in the air.

name: Stinger
descriptionLines: &7An anti-air lock-on rocket launcher
&7Mostly one-shots drones, munitions and planes

name: EMP Launcher
descriptionLines: &7An anti-air launcher which shoots small EMP fields
&7EMP field travel forward and disable on impact

name: Satellite Radar Kit

descriptionLines: &7Radar satellite kit with launch pad, carrier rocket and control interface.
&7Needs a proper setup before it shows anything.

name: Extra Health
descriptionLines: &7Provides 5 extra health points

name: Recon FPV Drones
descriptionLines: &7Controllable FPV drone for recon and scanning enemy players
&7Long-range drone with longer battery life, but with slower speed and almost no impact explosion power

name: Mythic Weapon Voucher (2/2)
descriptionLines: &7One of two vouchers: one is taken from gadgets, one from utility
&7With both vouchers you may take any &4&lMythic &7weapon
